title: KID FIRING HOLDS FIRE AT THE STALL
why: Found by the whole-game bug hunt of 2026-10-08. With Kid firing on, player 2 could open the Peddler stall and browse while a machine or a hostile pillager came into range, and his gun fired by itself through the panel, round after round. That spent his magazine, made noise that drew more machines, turned him, and a round could hit the Peddler beside him and shut the stall. A click, the pad trigger and a held A were already kept off the gun while the stall is open; Kid firing now waits too, and starts again when the stall shuts.
now: Kid firing no longer shoots while player 2 has the Peddler stall open.
